findings.title: Prediction confidence on the sample
findings.observation: 28% of sampled images are predicted with confidence below 55%.

findings.title: No time region stands out beyond where the candles are
findings.observation: The largest deviation from candle share is in the middle third (-0.9 pp), and its interval includes zero.

findings.title: Grad-CAM avoids the middle price band
findings.observation: The middle price band receives 41.1% of Grad-CAM mass but holds 44.2% of the candle pixels (-3.2 pp relative to candle share).

findings.title: Attention concentrates on candles more than their area implies
findings.observation: 55.3% of Grad-CAM mass lies on candle pixels, which cover 12.0% of the image on average.

findings.title: Attention patterns are heterogeneous across images
findings.observation: Median correlation between an image's map and the sample mean map is 0.12 (IQR 0.07–0.17).

findings.title: Some images have no positive Grad-CAM evidence
findings.observation: 29 of 200 sampled images produced an all-zero map at layer conv2d_2 and were excluded from the aggregates.

findings.title: pred 0 and pred 1 images attend differently to the middle third
findings.observation: Attention share in the middle third differs by +2.3 pp (pred 0 minus pred 1). 1 of 6 region comparisons exclude zero.

findings.title: Masking any third lowers the predicted class's probability
findings.observation: With the white baseline, masking the middle price band changes the predicted class's probability by -5.63 pp on average, the largest of 6 regions; its interval overlaps the others'. 6 of 6 regions shift the probability in the same direction with an interval ex

findings.title: No measurable recency preference
findings.observation: Per image, Δ p after masking the recent third minus Δ after masking the oldest third = -0.09 pp (white baseline).

findings.title: 82 of 128 channels in conv2d_2 never activate
findings.observation: 82 channels had zero activation on every sampled image. When most channels are inactive, the network may have lost capacity during training (for example through 'dead' ReLUs).

findings.title: 1 channels separate the labels — no more than chance would give
findings.observation: 1 of 128 channels have a Cohen's d interval excluding zero (about 6.4 expected by chance). Strongest: channel 28 (d = 0.36).

findings.title: The penultimate representation is spread over many directions
findings.observation: PC1 explains 36.1% and PC2 18.6% of the variance. PC1's alignment with the classifier direction is |cos| = 0.40.

findings.title: 80 of 128 penultimate units are always zero
findings.observation: 80 units never activated on the sample, so the classifier reads at most 48 effective features.
